title: Monolayer CuBr-based gas sensor to detect habitat and industry-relevant molecules with high sensitivity and selectivity: a first-principles study
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,16076-16087
DOI: 10.1039/D4RA06492E, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Shamiala Pervaiz, M. Usman Saeed, Hazrat Ali, Y. Saeed, Aamir Khan, Yousef Mohammed Alanazi
The adsorption characteristics of some environmental gas molecules (HF, CO, CO2, SO2, H2S, NH3, NO and NO2) on the surface of a CuBr monolayer have been studied using DFT+U calculations with Grimme scheme DFT-D2.
